mission.title: Intel Recovery
mission.description: Eliminate an Exile threat and recover stolen data.

phase.briefing: Last night, the Exiles attacked one of our stations and killed our team there. Infiltrate the base, eliminate any remaining Exiles, and recover information that has been left exposed to Exile hands.

enter.say: Once you've taken care of the Exiles, you'll have to recover the two disks in the computer system. You might also see a team of Redpills on site -- don't attack them. We don't want to cause any trouble with the Truce.

objective.text: Upload the disks at a hardline
Don't let the Zion Operatives die
